subject: CloudForge executive onramp — CIO+VP demo: propose swap & confirm
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amira Khan <amira.khan@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudForge executive onramp — initial calendar ask

Hi Amira,

Thanks again for taking the time last week — really excited to get CloudForge into a short executive onramp so we can walk the CIO/VP through how Redwood would land in your infra and the expected latency/cost profile for your workloads.

Two asks to get this across the line:
- Can you confirm whether your CIO (Liam) and VP of Platform are available during the week of Aug 17?
- If that week is tight, would you be open to swapping to Aug 20 afternoon (PDT) — we can compress to a 35-minute executive demo + 10-minute Q&A.

Attached: a lightweight agenda (CloudForge_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf) — runs 35m with a tailored section on private deployments and dedicated capacity.

Ben (copied) can handle any follow-up on licensing or pilot sizing, and Marissa will lead the brief and recording logistics. If you prefer a different format (no recording, or a 1:1 pre-brief with the CIO), tell us and we’ll adapt.

Best,
David

--
David Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[d] +1 415-555-0192
From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@cloudforge.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@cloudforge.com>, procurement@cloudforge.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudForge executive onramp — initial calendar ask

Hi David — thanks, agenda looks good. A few notes from our side:

- Liam can do Aug 20 but only 1:00–1:40pm PDT (he's in back-to-back meetings otherwise).
- Our VP of Platform is OOO the week of Aug 17.
- Procurement looped in for the SOW/contract path; they typically ask for a short SOW ahead of exec review.

If Aug 20 at 1:00 works for you and Ben/Marissa can be on the call, let’s lock it. Also please include the list of permissions/data access the demo will require (if any) — Liam’s assistant is sensitive to early security asks.

Thanks,
Amira

--

Thanks for the clarity — Aug 20 1:00–1:40pm PDT works for us. Proposed next steps:

1) We’ll hold 1:00–1:45pm on Aug 20 (35m demo + 10m buffer) and send a calendar invite with dial-in.
2) Attached a draft SOW outline for procurement to review (SOW-Draft-CloudForge.docx). Ben, can you pick this up and draft a concise SOW (~1 page) for procurement’s intake?
3) Marissa/Sofia will take the lead on logistics and recording preference (we can opt out if preferred).

Ben — would you be able to prepare a pricing range and the 30-day pilot terms by EOD Aug 6? Procurement has asked for an early read.

Amira — regarding permissions, we only need a small demo dataset and a breakout for showing Private deployment options — no production credentials. I’ll include a short checklist in the calendar invite.

Thanks all — I’ll draft the invite once Ben confirms.

Best,
David

--

From: Amira Khan <amira.khan@cloudforge.com>

Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:08:00 -07:00

David — that plan sounds great, thank you. Liam confirmed the 1:00 slot, procurement acknowledged receipt of the SOW draft and will review it tomorrow. A couple quick items:

- Liam would prefer no recording and a 5-min section at the end focused purely on security controls (SOC2, VPC & KMS) — can Marissa and Sofia handle that?
- For the dataset, we’ll share a redacted sample (CSV) and an internal doc with IP constraints before Aug 18.

Once Ben sends the pilot pricing, we’ll route to procurement and Liam’s EA for the final calendar hold.

Best,
Amira
